fig1_binomial_pmf.svg: Binomial pmf P(X=k)=C(n,k) p^k (1-p)^{n-k} for n=10 and p=0.2, 0.5, 0.8 (bars), computed from binom_pmf. The mean sits at np; the shape is right-skewed for p<0.5, symmetric at p=0.5, and left-skewed for p>0.5.
fig2_normal_approx.svg: The Bin(30, 1/2) pmf (bars) with the normal density N(np, np(1-p)) overlaid (orange), using binom_mean and binom_std for the parameters. Near the peak the bell tracks the bars: the de Moivre-Laplace limit.
